# Ordinary decoration script permission

The 60 references use the unmodified D2 MathJax 3.2.2 bundle at ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee. The generator validates all three asset hashes, creates a fresh VM for each formula/mode, and records complete SVG plus kind/text/explicit-attribute/own-property trees before the unchanged renderer. The first 48 references are byte-identical to the preserved D071 preparation; twelve further controls cover both script orders and genuine duplicate superscripts. Display measurements are derived from the raw primary SVG.

The accepted predecessor is efd6d63071862218af992a6074e3c8680b634ab4. ParseUtil.underOver sets subsupOK on its returned node. This change adds that own property to ordinary munder/mover returns. Existing D072 direct-base normalization, D073 scripted-base normalization, brace OP atoms, bar's Accent route, script attachment and rendering stay unchanged.

All 60 complete SVGs are raw-primary exact. Twenty false subscript errors become valid formulas, forty SVG controls remain byte-identical, and ten required primary errors remain exact. Twelve explicit-attribute trees and ten complete own-property trees are raw primary. The other fifty cases retain 126 finite, exact whole-map metadata boundaries. Every map is observed unchanged in the accepted compiler, either in the same formula or, where the old formula stopped with an error, in its exact decoration prefix before the later script. Each qualification names the primary and expected complete map, node path/kind, accepted witness file/hash and all matching source-shape paths. Kind, text, children and every other attribute/property remain primary; no generic omission or SVG normalization is allowed.

The 48 private constructor snapshots cover all six ordinary commands and both braces, x/sum/scripted-sum bases, and both modes. They bind the complete accepted constructor projection; the only expected change is own subsupOK:true on the returned ordinary node. Brace trees and descendants remain exact. The property is not serialized as a MathML attribute. Public duplicate-script cases establish that permission does not erase the existing occupied-slot rules.

The inherited D072 and D073 primary fixtures remain byte-identical. Their 22 and four false permission-error qualifications respectively are removed: all 60 and all 48 SVGs now match raw primary. Remaining metadata is again bound to complete unchanged accepted maps. Existing constructor assertions now require the source-defined permission; the separate normalization helper's synthetic ownership host still has no permission.

Regeneration: `node testdata/generate-decoration-permission.cjs /path/to/pinned/d2latex /separate/output`. The generator reads only formula/name/mode inputs from the fixture, never expected output values. Raw actual predecessor and candidate SVG/trees, complete per-map provenance, required-error results, old-production negative tests and initial capture corrections are preserved in the external source-review evidence.
